[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Birdloe''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] who served as second-in-command to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sodarra]]. Birdloe was unfamiliar with the workings of modified [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] such as the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], lacking both the skills to [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] such a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and an understanding of their repair. Unbeknownst to Sodarra, Birdloe was a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for [[Governor-General/Legends|Governor-General]] [[Nox Vellam|Vellam]], relaying the ''Falcon''{{'s}} movements to the renegade [[Governor/Legends|governor]] in his hunt for [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="SL" />
